results.title: China Is Investing in Africa’s Factory Moment. Will It Stay? – The Diplomat
results.snippet:
Seventy years since “Little Swallow” was written, China produces around 28 percent of the world’s manufacturing value added. Africa’s share of global manufacturing output, by contrast, has fallen from about 3 percent in the 1970s to less than 2 percent today, even as 10 to 12 million young Africans enter the workforce every year.
